subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept stricter Signal native-only `requireMention` behavior for existing groups with configured bot identity but no text mention patterns?
rationale: The code change is localized and well-covered, but it intentionally changes upgrade behavior for a user-facing Signal group delivery path, so automation should not decide the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Accept Stricter Native Gating
options.body: Merge with the documented behavior that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups now drop unmentioned group messages into bounded pending context when bot identity is configured.

options.title: Require A Transition Path
options.body: Ask for an explicit migration note, opt-in strict mode, or compatibility window if preserving old pass-through behavior matters for existing deployments.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: Pause this PR and dependent follow-ups if native metadata should not make Signal mention detection enforceable yet.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Native Gating
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented behavior that native-only Signal `requireMention` groups now drop unmentioned group messages into bounded pending context when bot identity is configured.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared mention-policy and Signal event-handler history makes this the best available routing owner for the compatibility decision.
